excerpt: Vulcan Energy Resources Ltd (ASX:VUL) has broken ground on the first phase of its major geothermal and lithium extraction plant (G-LEP) in the Upper Rhine Valley in Germany.

labels.summary: Vulcan Energy Resources Ltd has commenced construction on the first phase of its geothermal and lithium extraction plant (G-LEP) in Germany's Upper Rhine Valley. This project represents a significant milestone in combining renewable geothermal energy production with lithium extraction for the growing battery market.
